title: Spicy Korean-Style Fish Sujebi
description: A spicy Japanese-inspired fish sujebi dish, incorporating the bold flavors of Korean chili flakes. This recipe yields a hearty and flavorful meal.

ingredients.name: Fish (cod or pollock, cut into bite-sized pieces)

instructions: 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
2. Cook the sujebi noodles according to the package instructions.
3. In a separate pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
4. Add the green onions and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add the fish and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until cooked through.
6. Add the gochujang and gochugaru to the pan and stir to combine.
7. Add the cooked noodles to the pan and toss to combine with the spicy sauce.
8. Season with flaky sea salt and soy sauce to taste.
9. Serve hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
